01 / APPEARANCE

A cleaner Scratch

Refreshed home, project, profile, studio, message, Search, Explore, and My Stuff pages. Choose light, dark, or your system theme.

02 / PROJECTS

Follow the remix tree

See how public projects connect. Explore remix branches, find the original, and open projects from their thumbnails in a dedicated tree view.

03 / SAVED PROJECTS

Keep a project shelf

Save up to 100 project links on your device. Return to them from your homepage or workbench, without adding a Scratch favorite.

04 / PROJECT VIEWING

Less distraction, more play

Hide surrounding notes and lower-page content with distraction-free mode. Scratch’s original player and fullscreen control are still there.

05 / HOMEPAGE

Meet your uWidget

Choose a welcome message, public statistics, recent activity, continue browsing, or a custom greeting. Pick a compact or expanded view—or hide it.

06 / NAVIGATION

A handy home sidebar

Jump to Scratch pages and your settings. Open overview, project rankings, engagement, and saved projects. Collapse it when you want more space.

07 / PUBLIC INSIGHTS

See the numbers

Explore public project counts, followers, views, loves, favorites, and remixes on profiles and in the Statistics widget. Coverage is shown alongside the data.

08 / DISCOVERY

Find it in the results

Filter loaded project titles in Search, Explore, and My Stuff, with live result counts. Keep using Scratch’s sorting and load-more controls.

09 / COMMUNITY

Community recognition

Badges recognize Scratch Team accounts, users with more than 1,000 followers, and selected community members. Tooltips explain each badge.

10 / ACTIVITY

Pick up where you left off

Opt in to local project-page visit history for recent activity and continue browsing. Public insights can also show newly observed followers in its sample.

11 / PREFERENCES

Your own workbench

Adjust accents, spacing, widget size, and individual features with a live appearance preview. Export or import preferences, reset them, or switch BetterScratch off.

12 / SCRATCH NEWS

Stay in the loop

BetterScratch update announcements appear alongside Scratch’s own news, so you can discover new tools without losing the community updates.

Reduced motion and individual feature switches

Your Scratch stays yours

Useful tools.
No extra tracking.

BetterScratch doesn’t change your project files or ask for your account tokens. The Scratch editor stays untouched.

No analytics

No third-party statistics service, remote code, or analytics. Public Scratch API requests don’t send account cookies.

Saved on your device

Your shelf, banners, visit history, and public-data cache stay local. Preferences use Chrome sync. Visit history is opt-in.

You’re in control

Public data, badges, and individual features can be switched off. You can disable the extension whenever you like.

A few things to know

Before you add it.

Is BetterScratch available in the Chrome Web Store?

The listing is coming soon. For now, Add to Chrome opens the Chrome Web Store homepage. BetterScratch’s current development version is installed in Chrome as an unpacked extension.

Will it change my projects or the editor?

No. BetterScratch adds tools and styling around Scratch’s community pages. It doesn’t change project files, and editor, embed, and fullscreen routes are excluded.

Are the statistics complete account totals?

Public insights read up to 40 public projects per snapshot. Larger accounts show sample coverage and lower bounds, rather than claiming complete totals. Follower activity reflects newly observed accounts in a sample, not confirmed follow dates.

Are the badges official Scratch verification?

No. They’re BetterScratch community recognition, not proof of identity or official Scratch endorsement. A badge’s tooltip explains why the account qualifies.

Can I see every remix?

The tree shows public projects returned by Scratch and loads branches as you explore. Private or deleted projects and complete historical trees may not be available. Public-data access needs to be enabled.
